scope: Accurate updater status and recoverable actions, cleaner accessible Updates surface, package-derived version identity, and fewer vulnerable development dependencies without relaxing lint rules.
implementation: Use electron-updater availability instead of treating any returned version as an update. Distinguish unchecked/current states and preserve ready/download state across startup, hourly, tray and Settings checks.

Return authoritative snapshots on every manual check, retain Restart when no new event fires, ignore stale initial responses and late checks after native events, recover failed check/restart requests and prevent duplicate actions.
Use shared theme surfaces/buttons, semantic status colors, accessible progress and wrapped layouts. Remove pulsing restart decoration and duplicate error text.
Use the built package version in renderer startup diagnostics and Settings fallbacks.
Upgrade TypeScript ESLint7 to8.71.2 with existing ESLint8/rules, remove unused Storybook actions/essentials, correct global ImportMeta types and remove an unused catch binding.
Require component-documentation builds in CI and retain both-theme updater screenshots in native artifacts.

baseline.native_check_result: Three expected application regression failures; not queue failures. Exact old IPC handler extraction tested with controlled updater responses; no production updater contact.
baseline.review_finding: An early manual check could invalidate an initial ready lookup, then hide Restart indefinitely because native availability alone emitted no new event. Added two deferred-response regressions and both native fixture cases.

test_hygiene.qualification: Only the existing ready/restart test changed after the67-test pass, to await its action in async act. All application/configuration bytes stayed unchanged; the targeted file rerun removed its React warning.

checks: Uncached strict lint with unchanged warning/rule gates
Actionlint with default ShellCheck for both modified workflows; release input YAML checks
Exact lockfile install with unchanged package metadata and source guards
verification.audit_qualification: Affected-package entries fell24 to15 and high entries11 to5; production remains0. Remaining development findings are not resolved. Package/lock hashes equal the audited candidate.

source_guard.qualification: Manual hashes sealed after formatting; not an immutable queue snapshot.

verification.full_ci: Required after this integration. Parent3d23e0f CI is green but does not establish acceptance for these new changes.

dependency_isolation.qualification: Pending isolated native job has an independent byte-identical dependency copy. Main npm ci cannot mutate its dependencies. No caches deleted or queue jobs cancelled.

limitations: Local native theme/build and isolated Storybook jobs remain pending unless their receipts explicitly show success. No pass is inferred from the short gates. Full integrated unit/native/build/Storybook and platform verification is required in CI.
Updater fixtures do not establish real installer download, signature validation, restart installation or successful auto-update.
